name: A quiet Mac lets Boop sleep, never lonely
case: The person comes back to the Mac, opens claude and leaves it idle, prompting nothing and never touching Boop, for two and a half hours. Boop is never lonely: with nothing going on it dozes off, and the idle check-ins stop.
why: Core.dozeOffMs: Boop dozes an hour after every agent comes to rest; TranscriptView.idleWindowMs: idle check-ins stop 2 h after the last activity; lonely is for being ignored while you work, not for a quiet Mac
